bullets: New: Fridays, a reminder to import the day's appointment list and send each clinician their weekly digest by 4 PM. Patients > Weekly digests opens them any day.

New: Each digest lists the clinician's patients in treatment by LASFIR and MRN: this week's kept, missed and cancelled visits, the course so far, last and next follow-up, and what's coming up next week. Copy it, open the email (To, CC and subject filled in), paste and send, then Mark sent.
New: Clinicians can be left out of the digest. Emails and opt-outs are on the Clinician Digest sheet. The CC is in Settings.
New: 2 treatments cancelled within 7 days asks for a telephone note to the clinician.
Changed: Clinicians are named from NextGen's Rendering column with their credential (Wendy Marussich, PMHNP), not "Dr.".
Changed: A missed or cancelled follow-up only counts if the next one isn't booked within 5 days.
Changed: A missed-treatment telephone note is logged on each missed visit it covers.
Fixed: Settings > Eligibility feed URL now saves.
Changed: In full screen, this bell sits next to the TMS name at the top left and stays there.
Fixed: Theta burst visits ("TMS Theta Tx" in NextGen) now import. They were skipped, about a quarter of Castro's chair bookings on both chairs.
Changed: A patient's tab belongs where most of their treatments are booked. The MT only decides a tie. An MT booked at Post with the course booked on Castro's chairs is Castro's.
Changed: A tab counts when its first rows show the patient's MRN by its label, even if the MRN isn't in A4 or the tab is named differently.

New: Everyone booked on our chairs shows on Today and Schedule with their LASFIR, MRN (last four) and time, tab or not. A guest's tracker link is on their card, not a red flag, and Don't ask again stops the ask for good.

New: Import > Other clinics' lists. Add the same ALL TMS report from other clinics after this one. Their visits for our patients fill in as Alt Clinic rows and help decide where a tab belongs; none go on our schedule.
New: A treatment on another clinic's chair is marked Alt Clinic and stays off our chairs. It shows on our schedule only when the patient's MT is here.
New: Provider (E2) comes from NextGen's Rendering column.
New: 2 missed in a row asks for a telephone note to the provider, with a draft to copy into NextGen. Each miss after that asks for a new entry on it.
New: A follow-up missed or cancelled asks to rebook it. If it's still not rebooked 2 business days later, it asks for a telephone note to the provider.
New: Patients flags a follow-up not booked between the MT and MT redo, around treatments 20 to 27, or within 7 days of the last treatment.
Changed: The Dev Update bell now lives in full screen only, right of the tracker name at the top left. It is gone from the side pane.
Changed: A red dot on the bell means something new. Nothing pops up any more: click the bell to read it, and the dot clears.
Changed: You can still drag the bell away; drop it near its spot and it goes back.
Changed: The sun and moon on the light/dark button are whole again.
Changed: The Dev Update bell floats again. Drag it anywhere; it starts at the bottom right.
Changed: Light/dark shows half of each symbol with a slash between them.
Changed: Refresh, full screen and light/dark mode are now icons at the top right of each page, with this bell right after them. Point at an icon to see what it does.
New: Light/dark shows sun / moon. The one on the right is the mode you switch to, and they swap places when you press it.
Changed: The tracker shows a short loading screen while it reads the workbook, then asks you to "Enter your name". Anyone can be using it, not just the tech at the chair.
Changed: On the name screen your names sit under the heading with more room, and a long list scrolls instead of being cut off.

New: during the session, tick LumaPay card on file and the patient's verbal consent to collect the copay at time of service. It's on today's visit in the patient view and in Complete session, saved to the visit's Notes with your name and the time.
New: once a day the tracker asks who is using it, from this workbook's own list. Pick your name or add yourself. It fills in Treating technician and signs the Edit log.
The clinic is never assumed. It comes from Settings or the workbook's name, and once saved only an admin can change it.
New: the bell in the top right lists what changed in the tracker. A note like this one appears once after each update.
Banners you dismiss or snooze stay hidden when you switch between the task pane and full screen.
